name: roast-chat
description: Chat-web roast from public URLs, uploads, or pasted sources. Default comedy-club voice. Does not walk a host tree. Matches the user's language.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include a project URL, attached or uploaded files, or pasted sources.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: roast-report
outputs.description: Structured roast; empty when there is no usable evidence.
